def makegrid(h,w,centers):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in centers:
        for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]: g[r+dr][c+dc]=2
    return g
def additions(inp,out):
    return [(r,c,out[r][c]) for r in range(len(inp)) for c in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[r][c]!=out[r][c]]
